ungrouped-map.script: const steps = params.paths.map(path => g.tool({ name: "grep", input: { path, pattern: "needle" } }));

ungrouped-for.script: for (const path of ["a.txt", "b.txt"]) { g.tool({ name: "grep", input: { path, pattern: "needle" } }); }

ungrouped-helper.script: const search = path => g.tool({ name: "grep", input: { path, pattern: "needle" } }); ["a.txt", "b.txt"].map(search);

grouped-map.script: const steps = params.paths.map(path => g.tool({ name: "grep", input: { path, pattern: "needle" } })); g.parallel(steps); g.script({ results: steps, script: "return results.map(result => result.output);" });
